scope: Keep an applied external (NIP-07/NIP-46) signer on the NDK singleton across connectNdk/getNdk(localKey) calls; only an explicit disconnect returns NDK to a local key.
files_to_modify: app/src/lib/ndkClient.ts (remember the external signer; applySigner skips while it is set; apply it on singleton creation; releaseNdkExternalSigner(privateKeyHex))
docs/behavior (signer topic, if it states the signing identity)

behavior.sticky: applyNdkSigner(ext) then getNdk(k)/connectNdk(k) leaves ndk.signer === ext.
behavior.early_apply: applyNdkSigner before the singleton exists: the singleton is created with ext.
behavior.release: releaseNdkExternalSigner(k) clears ext and binds a private-key signer for k; releaseNdkExternalSigner(null) clears ext so the next getNdk(k) binds k.
behavior.local_unchanged: Without an external signer, getNdk(k) binds k and rebinds when k changes.

tests: Unit ndkClient signer binding cases above against the real singleton, incl. a signed event's pubkey
non_goals: the NIP-46 local-identity regeneration on mount
callers that sign directly with createPrivateKeySigner (they already prefer activeEventSignerOverride)
